name: releaseInFlight
title: A worker releases its lane while its statement can still land; the next holder inserts the same batch
timing: model time is in ticks; a worker's fence = sent + TTL - MARGIN - BUDGET, its statement lands by fence + BUDGET + SLACK, another worker may take the lane at sent + TTL + MARGIN (MARGIN = BUDGET = 1 tick)

steps.action: PUT e1/000 with request 1; S3 commits it
FATAL: load balancing gives the lane back (lease CAS to no owner, fencing epoch 2) with S1 still in flight
take the lane at once (a released lease needs no wait), rewrite the checkpoint
count check: e1/0 still absent (S1 has not landed)
S1 lands too (a statement of a worker that no longer holds the lane)

design.guard: mayRelease(w) with RELEASE_GUARD: every statement of the worker's incarnation is past settledBy = fence + MARGIN + BUDGET + SLACK
design.effect: step 5 is disabled until t > 4 (releaseInFlightDesignTest); by then S1 has landed or can no longer land, so w2's check sees it (releaseSettledDesignTest)
design.code: D8/D9: a release is allowed only once none of the lane's statements can still land (worker.rs coord::may_act; code mutant release_in_flight)

dropped: the writer's 200 and ack; the edge's startPush/send/apply merged into step 1
